command: python3 tools/report_audit.py verdict --report reports/巴菲特Checklist-美股七姐妹-20260818.md --results <30 extracted points> --output-json

sources.fundamental_data: StockPik weekly screener, SEC EDGAR-derived fields

limitations: report_audit.py caps one run at 30 sampled points; 49 points were detected and 30 were audited

PASS means audited reported values matched the supplied fetched values within 1%; it does not validate qualitative scores, model assumptions, source independence, or investment conclusions
